$schema_doc: Golden-Route fixtures (E03-T5, docs/07-testing-qa.md §3b). Types: 'distance' (route length within ±tolerance), 'restriction' (🔴 safety: small profile MUST enter forbidden_bbox, large/heavy profile MUST NOT — both directions asserted; a maxweight case is a restriction with restriction.kind='maxweight'), 'monotonic' (route duration non-decreasing over an ascending profile list — catches swapped profile→costing mappings), 'no_route' (expects NO_ROUTE). Region selection: the runner (e2e/golden-routes/runner.test.ts) runs only cases whose 'region' equals GOLDEN_REGION (li|de, default li). LI cases run in the per-PR CI job 'golden-routes-li' (Merge-Blocker, retry:0, bail:1 — a failed safety/monotonic case HARD-ABORTS with no retry/tolerance). DE cases run only in the nightly 'golden-routes-de' job. 'unverified':true marks a case whose expected value or restriction has NOT been confirmed against a live Valhalla run in this sandbox (Overpass/geofabrik are egress-blocked here); the nightly DE job runs continue-on-error so unverified failures are logged, not blocking. Freeze the value / confirm the OSM way-id and flip unverified:false after the first green nightly run. SAFETY-DEMO (acceptance #3): LI has no map-restriction data, so the restriction assertion cannot be exercised on LI — see the note on the DE restriction cases for exactly how a swapped height/weight mapping makes them fail; on LI the monotonic case is the closest available guard (a swapped top_speed/avg_speed mapping that made a larger vehicle route faster would break its non-decreasing assertion).

OD pair proven routable by the existing CI smoke (Vaduz->Schaan). Profiles ascend in size/weight and DESCEND in avg_speed_kmh (Kastenwagen 110 -> Camper 95 -> Alkoven 7.5t 80), so route duration must be non-decreasing even on identical geometry (top_speed caps ETA). Guards against a swapped profile->costing mapping. Runs on LI in the per-PR gate.
